reason: The survivor is the check of section.Leg.Ref(), which re-validates the carried leg block hash as 32 bytes of hex. finality.ParseSection has already refused a leg whose blockHash is not exactly that (strictHex32), a few lines earlier, so Ref cannot fail on a parsed section. The other guards of the same text in this function (reading the file, parsing the section) are killed by TestReportFinalityFileRefusesAFileItCannotReadOrParse.
